ISS AI Native转型工作坊ISS AI-Native Transformation Workshop

AI Accelerator的业务价值实现探讨 · 主持人：TomExploring how AI Accelerator creates business value · Host: Tom

从真实结果倒推Work backward from outcomes

从九组实践与失败经验出发，辨认业务结果、流程断点、知识输入和必须保留的人类判断；不把演示流畅写成已上线结果。Start from nine practices and failures to identify outcomes, flow breakpoints, knowledge inputs and human judgement; a smooth demo is not a launch result.

把能力放进流程Put capability into flow

让数据、语义、模型、Agent、Skill、页面与受控 Action 在同一条业务链上协同，明确权限、证据、回写和接管边界。Connect data, semantics, models, Agents, Skills, pages and controlled Actions in one business chain with explicit access, evidence, writeback and takeover boundaries.

从一次成功到重复交付From one success to repeatable delivery

Day 1 形成候选、风险和实施输入；Day 2 用真实业务与企业能力核验资产、组织和路线，最后确认继续、调整或停止的下一决策门。Day 1 forms candidates, risks and implementation inputs. Day 2 validates assets, organization and route with real business and enterprise capability, then confirms the next gate.

共同语言：Shared language:场景、Owner、能力边界、证据、复用条件与下一决策门。Scene, Owner, capability boundary, evidence, reuse conditions and the next decision gate.

005 · MD §D1.2.0 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
MD §D1.2.0 · Day 1 · 九案例总览MD §D1.2.0 · Day 1 · Nine-case overview

九案例：从结果倒推可重复交付Nine cases: work backward from outcomes to repeatable delivery

每例后续都有预录视频位置与七段展开；结果数字、效率或组织变化只在证据核验后记录，不在此页造数。Every case has a video slot and seven-part deep dive later. Numbers, efficiency and organizational change are recorded only after evidence checks.

01UNIS 港口｜无头 AgentUNIS port | headless Agent

从哪里开始：CSR ticket → 高频问题 → 候选后台能力。Where to start: CSR tickets → repeated issues → candidate background capability.

02WMS｜本地代码与定制开发WMS | local code and custom build

在既有代码和本地环境中生成、校验并受控发布页面。Generate, verify and release pages in the existing code and local environment.

03Rate & Quote｜数据本体Rate & Quote | data ontology

让业务与开发共享语义，再连接分析页和业务表单。Create shared language for business and development, then connect analytics and forms.

04BO｜FDE 与专家验证BO | FDE and expert validation

规则、本体、样本与专家审核分开评测，准确性不外推。Evaluate rules, ontology, samples and expert review separately; do not extrapolate accuracy.

05Record & Reply｜知识采集Record & Reply | knowledge capture

用视频降低线下流程表达门槛，形成经审核的 SOP 草案。Use video to lower the barrier for offline-process capture and draft a reviewed SOP.

06CEC / Genesys｜观察到受控执行CEC / Genesys | observe to controlled action

经授权观察坐席流程，区分可自动、辅助和必须人工的动作。Observe agent flows with authorization and separate automatic, assisted and human-only actions.

07CFS / Depot｜小而杂的流程CFS / Depot | small, messy flows

SOP → Workflow → 自然语言变更，再经回归、发布与回滚。SOP → Workflow → natural-language change, followed by regression, release and rollback.

08iCEO｜问答与决策边界iCEO | Q&A versus decision boundary

受控问答可单独验证；复杂经营决策不以演示代替业务合格。Controlled Q&A can be tested separately; complex operating decisions are not demo-qualified.

09其他坑｜法规、知识与模型投资Other pitfalls | law, knowledge and model investment

先补知识、权限和评测，再决定模型投资；必要时缩小、停止或转交。Stabilize knowledge, access and evaluation before model investment; narrow, stop or hand off when needed.

观看顺序Viewing order先确认业务结果和证据，再看前/后流程、实施与组织变化，最后填写ISS对标和重复交付条件。Confirm outcome and evidence first, then review before/after flow, implementation and organization, before recording ISS comparison and reuse conditions.

006 · MD §D1.2.1.1 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.1DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.1

先从业务结果与改造前流程入手Start with the outcome and current flow

不要先假设“需要一个 Agent”：先把重复问题、交接和可验收结果说清楚，再选择可控切入点。Do not assume “we need an Agent” first: clarify repeated work, handoffs and acceptance before choosing a controlled entry point.

01 · OUTCOME

痛点与期望结果Pain and intended outcome

  • 重复工作多，但优先级、责任和触发条件不清。
  • 建议结果：用经授权的 CSR ticket 找到可审核的问题分类。
  • 再形成一个有输入、输出、Action、升级和 Owner 的候选 Agent。
  • 不预先承诺节省、排名、模型能力或运营收益。
  • Repetition is high, but priority, ownership and triggers are unclear.
  • Intended outcome: build a reviewable issue taxonomy from authorised CSR tickets.
  • Then define an Agent candidate with inputs, outputs, Actions, escalation and Owner.
  • No pre-commitment to savings, rankings, model capability or operating gains.
02 · CURRENT FLOW

改造前流程（待用真实流程核对）Current flow (to verify with reality)

  • CSR 提交或状态变化
  • 人员查找订单、监控、派车、状态、结算信息
  • 多角色交接、补问并人工更新状态
  • 异常继续追踪或升级，结果留在工单与业务记录
  • CSR submission or status change
  • People look up order, monitoring, dispatch, status and settlement data
  • Handoffs, follow-up questions and manual status updates
  • Exceptions are tracked or escalated; results stay in tickets and records

建议用一张真实流程图逐项确认系统边界、交接和状态真值。Use one real process map to verify system boundaries, handoffs and the source of truth.

预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：一组已脱敏 CSR ticket → 问题合并 → 一条运输任务的触发、交接、异常接管与回放。Suggested recording: redacted CSR tickets → issue merging → one transport task through trigger, handoff, exception takeover and replay.

请明确标注：真实 / 脱敏 / 模拟；不写假 src，不嵌外链播放器。Label clearly: real / redacted / simulated. No fake src and no external player.

讨论Discussion哪一批 CSR ticket 可授权、可脱敏？这条原流程里，哪一步最适合作为首个小范围验证？Which CSR ticket batch can be authorised and redacted? Which step is the best narrow first validation?

007 · MD §D1.2.1.2 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.2DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.2

改造后闭环：正常运行，异常接管The target loop: run normally, take over safely

无头 Agent 的价值在于事件驱动的后台协作；安全边界在于缺失、冲突、高风险和失败都能停下来并交给人。A headless Agent coordinates work from events in the background; safety comes from stopping and handing off on missing, conflicting, risky or failed cases.

01 · NORMAL · 建议路径

一条正常运输任务One normal transport task

  • 事件、工单或状态变化触发。
  • 读取授权输入，校验身份、字段和当前状态。
  • 拆分子任务，调用必要 Connector/Tools。
  • 形成下一步 Action，完成后回写状态与上下文。
  • Trigger from an event, ticket or status change.
  • Read authorised inputs; validate identity, fields and current state.
  • Split subtasks and call required Connectors/Tools.
  • Propose or complete the next Action, then write back state and context.
02 · EXCEPTION · 建议路径

缺失、冲突与工具失败Missing, conflicting or failed

  • 缺失信息：暂停并列出缺口，不猜测。
  • 状态冲突：不覆盖，转人工核对真值。
  • 高风险 Action：人工确认后才允许继续。
  • 超时或工具失败：记录错误、重试和最后状态并升级。
  • Missing data: pause and list the gap; do not guess.
  • State conflict: do not overwrite; ask a human to verify.
  • High-risk Action: continue only after human confirmation.
  • Timeout or tool failure: log error, retries and last state, then escalate.
03 · WRITE-BACK · 已知边界＋待验证

接管、回写与最终结果Takeover, write-back and outcome

  • 已知边界：正常路径后台运行；异常保留完整上下文。
  • 建议记录：触发、输入、子任务、错误、人工决定、回写和关闭理由。
  • 订单、监控、派车、状态、结算的接口、权限和写回对象待验证。
  • 本案例没有已证实的自动决策执行或运营结果。
  • Known boundary: normal work may run in the background; exceptions keep full context.
  • Log trigger, inputs, subtasks, errors, human decision, write-back and closure reason.
  • Interfaces, access and write-back objects for order, monitoring, dispatch, status and settlement need verification.
  • No proven automated decision execution or operating result is claimed.

008 · MD §D1.2.1.3 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.3DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.3

实施不是先接接口，而是先形成可审核的能力卡Implementation starts with a reviewable capability card

从样本到小范围验证，再到采用与持续改进；以下困难是实施风险和建议机制，不是已发生的历史事实。Move from samples to narrow validation, then adoption and improvement. These are implementation risks and suggested mechanisms, not claimed historical facts.

01 · INPUT → FILTER

先把证据变成候选Turn evidence into candidates

  • 授权采集并脱敏 CSR ticket。
  • 提取类型、频率、动作、角色、异常、结果。
  • 合并相似问题，按频率、耗时、损失、数据可得性共同筛选。
  • Top 10/Top 6 只是展示规模，不虚构问题名单或排名。
  • Collect and redact authorised CSR tickets.
  • Extract type, frequency, actions, roles, exceptions and outcomes.
  • Screen by frequency, effort, loss and data availability together.
  • Top 10/Top 6 are display scales, not invented lists or rankings.
02 · BUILD

能力卡与小范围验证Capability card and narrow test

  • 写触发、输入、输出、Action、升级、Owner、权限。
  • 区分真实、脱敏、模拟数据和只读/可写边界。
  • 先验证读取、判断、异常和回放，再讨论写回或高风险动作。
  • Define trigger, inputs, outputs, Actions, escalation, Owner and access.
  • Separate real, redacted and simulated data, plus read-only/write limits.
  • Validate reading, judgement, exceptions and replay before write-back or risky Actions.
03 · RISKS · 建议机制

可能困难如何处理How to handle likely risks

  • 字段缺失或口径不一 → 字段字典与专家抽样复核。
  • 接口权限不足 → 权限清单、模拟环境和最小授权。
  • 异常样本稀少 → 故障注入、边界样本和人工回放。
  • 接管无 Owner → 明确接管人、响应时限和关闭条件。
  • Missing or inconsistent fields → data dictionary and expert sampling.
  • Insufficient access → access inventory, sandbox and least privilege.
  • Few exceptions → fault injection, boundary samples and human replay.
  • No takeover Owner → name the owner, response time and closure rule.
04 · ADOPT → IMPROVE

业务采用与持续改进Adoption and continuous improvement

  • ISS Biz（team）审核分类、规则、优先级和验收。
  • 通过演示、受控试运行和反馈入口指导何时确认、拒绝或接管。
  • 新工单与运行错误更新分类、规则和知识。
  • 发布前保留回归、业务审核和回滚，不承诺全面采用。
  • ISS Biz (team) reviews taxonomy, rules, priority and acceptance.
  • Use demos, controlled trials and feedback to teach confirm, reject and takeover points.
  • Update taxonomy, rules and knowledge from new tickets and runtime errors.
  • Keep regression, business review and rollback; do not promise broad adoption.
讨论Discussion谁审核问题合并？哪三个字段最先缺失？哪个困难要在首轮验证前先被关闭？Who reviews issue merging? Which three fields are most likely missing? Which risk must be closed before the first test?

本页只定义谁负责、如何验收和需要什么分母；没有实测数据就明确写“待补”，不把演示当成运营结果。Define ownership, acceptance and denominators first. Mark unmeasured data as “to collect”; a demo is not an operating result.

联合职责（建议确认）Joint responsibilities (to confirm)

验收与价值证据字段Acceptance and value evidence

  • 样本时间窗、任务分母、触发数、完成数、人工接管数。
  • 缺失信息、状态冲突、错误/重试、超时、异常回收。
  • 质量：分类、状态一致性、Action 合规性、人工复核。
  • 效率/成本：处理时长、人工主动时间、调用/接口/维护成本。
  • 每项带背景、周期、来源和对照口径；无实测则待补。
  • Sample window, task denominator, triggers, completions and takeovers.
  • Missing data, state conflicts, errors/retries, timeouts and recovery.
  • Quality: classification, state consistency, Action compliance and human review.
  • Efficiency/cost: processing time, active human time, call/interface/maintenance cost.
  • Attach context, period, source and comparator; mark unmeasured data to collect.
讨论Discussion谁是业务 Owner、专家审核人、接管人和运维人？验收分母、周期与质量等级由谁签认？Who are the business Owner, expert reviewer, takeover owner and operator? Who signs off denominator, period and quality grades?

010 · MD §D1.2.1.5 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.5DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.5

ISS 对标：先找事实差距，再谈迁移ISS benchmark: map factual gaps before migration

案例给出方法骨架，不等于 ISS 已具备数据、接口、组织或评测；会中要把每个差距填到 Owner 和证据。The case provides a method skeleton, not proof that ISS has the data, interfaces, organisation or evaluation. Fill every gap with an Owner and evidence.

KNOWN ANCHORS

当前已知锚点Known anchors

  • CSR ticket → Top 10 issues → Top 6 agent candidates。
  • 正常路径后台运行，异常进入人工确认。
  • 需要新工单、运行错误和业务 Owner 持续审核。
  • CSR tickets → Top 10 issues → Top 6 Agent candidates.
  • Normal work runs in the background; exceptions need human confirmation.
  • New tickets, runtime errors and business Owner review drive improvement.

以上是案例事实，不是 ISS 实测成熟度。These are case facts, not measured ISS maturity.

GAP MAP · 待填

五类差距与责任Five gaps and Owners

  • 知识：术语、状态、SOP、例外、授权。
  • 数据：ticket、订单、监控、派车、结算。
  • 接口：读写、权限、审计、测试环境。
  • 组织：业务 Owner、专家、FDE、接管与运维。
  • 评测：样本、分母、质量、错误、回滚门。
  • Knowledge: terms, states, SOPs, exceptions and access.
  • Data: tickets, orders, monitoring, dispatch and settlement.
  • Interfaces: read/write, access, audit and test environment.
  • Organisation: business, experts, FDE, takeover and operations.
  • Evaluation: samples, denominators, quality, errors and rollback gate.
MEETING FORM · 会中填写

用问题锁定下一步Questions for the meeting

  • 哪批 ticket 可授权、可脱敏？
  • 谁审核问题合并与优先级？
  • 哪个状态字段是业务真值？
  • 哪些 Action 只建议、必须确认或可模拟？
  • 谁接管、多久响应、如何关闭？
  • 什么记录能证明“完成”？
  • Which ticket batch can be authorised and redacted?
  • Who reviews issue merging and priority?
  • Which status field is the business truth?
  • Which Actions are suggest-only, confirmed or simulated?
  • Who takes over, within what time, and how is it closed?
  • What record proves completion?
讨论Discussion先填一行真实差距：证据在哪里、Owner 是谁、下一决策门是什么？Fill one factual gap first: where is the evidence, who owns it, and what is the next decision gate?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.1.5
011 · MD §D1.2.1.6 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.6DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.6

业务规则变更，要经过审核、回归与回滚Business rule changes need review, regression and rollback

可复用的是受控变更机制，不是把港口字段和规则未经验证地复制到第二个场景。Reuse the controlled change mechanism, not unverified port fields and rules copied into a second scene.

01 · CHANGE

业务提出规则Business proposes

  • 业务 Owner 提出规则、例外或状态变化。
  • 记录来源、授权范围、影响对象和版本。
  • 未经审核的个案不直接变成通用知识。
  • Business Owner proposes a rule, exception or state change.
  • Record source, access scope, affected objects and version.
  • Unreviewed cases do not become generic knowledge.
02 · REVIEW → BUILD

专家审核，FDE 改Expert reviews, FDE edits

  • 专家确认业务含义、例外和风险等级。
  • FDE 修改 Agent、Workflow、页面或规则。
  • 责任、权限和接口前置条件同步更新。
  • Experts confirm meaning, exceptions and risk.
  • FDE edits the Agent, Workflow, page or rule.
  • Ownership, access and interface prerequisites update together.
03 · TEST → RELEASE

回归后发布或回滚Regress, then release or roll back

  • 用正常、缺失、冲突、超时、高风险样本回归。
  • 业务 Owner 验收，受控发布并观测。
  • 不通过就回滚上一版本，记录理由。
  • Regress normal, missing, conflicting, timeout and risky cases.
  • Business Owner accepts; release under control and observe.
  • Roll back to the prior version when it fails; record why.
04 · REUSE

沉淀什么，重验什么Reuse versus revalidate

  • 可复用：能力卡、责任字段、日志、回放、评测、接管、发布机制。
  • 重验证：港口对象、状态、接口、权限、规则、完成定义和风险等级。
  • 第二场景不能由第一场景自动推断。
  • Reuse: capability card, roles, logs, replay, evaluation, takeover and release.
  • Revalidate: port objects, states, interfaces, access, rules, completion and risk.
  • Do not infer a second scene from the first.
讨论Discussion谁有权批准规则变更？回归集由谁维护？哪类知识可以进入核心库，哪类必须留在场景配置？Who may approve rule changes? Who maintains regression data? What enters the core knowledge base versus scene configuration?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.1.6
012 · MD §D1.2.1.7 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.7DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.1.7

可重复交付，但不强行产品化Repeatable delivery without forced productization

现场动手的目标是产出一份可审核的小范围草稿，而不是证明已有运营结果或把失败例隐藏起来。The hands-on goal is a reviewable narrow draft, not proof of operating results or a reason to hide failures.

01 · REPEATABLE METHOD

通用交付流程Repeatable method

  • 取样并脱敏 → 分类合并。
  • 按频率、耗时、损失、数据可得性筛选。
  • 写能力卡 → 画正常/异常闭环。
  • 连接或模拟 Tools → 建回归集。
  • 专家验收 → 受控发布/回滚 → 持续优化。
  • Sample and redact → merge taxonomy.
  • Screen by frequency, effort, loss and data availability.
  • Write capability card → map normal/exception loop.
  • Connect or simulate Tools → build regression set.
  • Expert acceptance → controlled release/rollback → improve.
02 · HANDS-ON · 建议

现场产出四件套Four hands-on outputs

  • 能力卡：触发、输入、输出、Action、升级、Owner。
  • 小范围草稿：一个问题的 Agent/Workflow。
  • 验收样本：正常、缺失、冲突和失败例。
  • 责任表：业务、专家、FDE、接口、接管、运维。
  • Capability card: trigger, inputs, outputs, Actions, escalation and Owner.
  • Narrow draft: one issue’s Agent/Workflow.
  • Acceptance samples: normal, missing, conflict and failure cases.
  • Responsibility sheet: business, expert, FDE, interface, takeover and operations.
03 · STOP / NARROW / HAND OFF

失败时的下一步When the test fails

  • 样本不足、规则不可审核、状态真值不明：缩小范围。
  • 权限或接口不可得：只读、模拟或转交治理。
  • 高风险动作无人接管：停止执行，不强行产品化。
  • 记录失败理由、责任人和下一决策门。
  • Few samples, unreviewable rules or unclear truth: narrow scope.
  • Missing access or interfaces: read-only, simulate or hand off.
  • No takeover for risky Actions: stop; do not force productization.
  • Record failure reason, Owner and next decision gate.

成功与否都要留下证据，失败不是可删除的演示噪音。Success and failure both stay in evidence; failure is not demo noise to delete.

动手Hands-onISS Biz（team）现在选哪一个重复问题？谁现场改规则，谁审核，谁把草稿带到下一次回归？Which repeated issue will ISS Biz (team) choose? Who edits the rule, reviews it and carries the draft into regression?

013 · MD §D1.2.2.1 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.1DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.1

WMS 动态表单：先证明业务结果，再谈生成速度WMS Dynamic Form: prove the business result before speed

痛点不是“没有页面”，而是需求、字段、接口和状态在交接中反复丢失；演示必须落在既有 WMS 本地环境。The pain is not a missing page; handoffs lose requirements, fields, interfaces and states. The demo must run in the existing WMS local environment.

改造前：反复交接Before: repeated handoffs

  • 仓库发现异常，口头或消息描述需求。The warehouse reports an exception by voice or message.
  • 业务与开发反复解释订单、料件、位置、状态和规则。Business and development clarify order, part, location, state and rules repeatedly.
  • 开发、联调、等待上线；外观正确不代表字段和接口正确。Development, integration and release wait; a correct look does not prove fields or interfaces.
01 · INPUT异常Exception
02 · HANDOFF解释Clarify
03 · BUILD开发Build
04 · WAIT联调/上线Integrate/release

期望结果（建议）：可追溯登记、正确状态回写、可审核测试、可维护版本。Expected result (suggested): traceable registration, correct state write-back, reviewable tests and maintainable versions.

预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：需求描述 → 代码生成 → WMS 本地运行 → 业务修改 → 测试 → 状态回写。请标注真实环境、脱敏数据或模拟路径；不写假 src。Suggested recording: requirement → code generation → WMS local run → business change → tests → state write-back. Label real, redacted or simulated paths; no fake src.

本页证据门Evidence gate

待补：WMS 版本、源码/权限范围、本地环境位置、样例数据批准人、改造前基线。To add: WMS version, source/access scope, local environment, sample-data approver and baseline.

讨论Discussion哪个 ISS 页面最适合先验证？谁确认真实、脱敏和模拟边界？Which ISS page is the best first validation, and who confirms real, redacted and simulated boundaries?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.2.1
014 · MD §D1.2.2.2 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.2DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.2

改造后闭环：正常任务、接管与状态回写After: normal task, takeover and state write-back

闭环的终点不是表单提交，而是有证据的业务状态变化；缺失信息和高风险 Action 必须停在人工确认门。The endpoint is not form submission, but an evidenced business-state change; missing data and high-risk Actions stop at human confirmation.

01 · NORMAL

正常任务Normal task

  • 输入订单、料件、位置、异常类型、照片、处理建议。Enter order, part, location, exception type, photo and recommendation.
  • 生成页面遵循既有字段、组件和 WMS 交互约定。The generated page follows existing fields, components and WMS interaction conventions.
  • 先在本地样例数据上复现流程。Reproduce the flow on local sample data first.

已知路径：需求→页面→本地验证。Known path: need → page → local validation.

02 · EXCEPTION

缺失信息与异常Missing data and errors

  • 缺订单、位置或异常类型：阻止提交并提示补齐。Missing order, location or type: block submission and request completion.
  • 无效状态、重复提交、接口超时：进入错误分支和重试/转人工。Invalid state, duplicate or timeout: use an error path and retry or hand off.
  • 具体必填规则、错误码和重试策略待 ISS 确认。Required rules, error codes and retry policy need ISS confirmation.
03 · CONTROL

人确认、回写与结果Human gate, write-back and result

  • 权限不足或证据不足：接管，不由生成结果替代决策。Insufficient access or evidence: hand off; generated output does not replace a decision.
  • 通过校验、权限、审核和接口测试后才回写状态。Write back only after validation, access, review and interface tests.
  • 记录原/新状态、操作者、时间、原因、附件和版本。Record old/new state, operator, time, reason, attachment and version.

最终结果（建议）：可追溯、一致、可回退；不是已实现收益。Final result (suggested): traceable, consistent and reversible; not a claimed realized benefit.

讨论Discussion哪些 Action 只能模拟？谁能确认、拒绝、接管和回滚？Which Actions must remain simulated? Who can confirm, reject, take over and roll back?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.2.2
015 · MD §D1.2.2.3 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.3DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.3

实施过程：把生成嵌入工程与采用反馈Implementation: embed generation in engineering and adoption feedback

建议先做小范围、可复现的真实流程；困难要进入机制，未证实的阻力不能写成历史事实。Start with a narrow, reproducible real flow; turn difficulties into mechanisms, not unverified history.

01 · INPUT

理解环境Understand

  • 代码、字段、组件、权限、校验、接口Code, fields, components, access, validation, interfaces
  • 本地环境与脱敏样例Local environment and redacted samples
02 · BUILD

生成与补齐Generate and complete

  • 自然语言需求生成页面Generate a page from natural language
  • 补字段校验、权限、错误、状态和 ActionAdd validation, access, errors, states and Actions
03 · CHECK

审核与回归Review and regress

  • 代码审核、构建、功能/接口测试Code review, build, functional/interface tests
  • 失败样本进入回归集Add failures to the regression set
04 · ADOPT

小步采用Adopt in steps

  • 一名授权用户跑低风险异常One authorised user runs a low-risk exception
  • 反馈→模板/组件/测试更新Feedback → update templates, components and tests

困难可能包括源码/接口不可得、状态不可复现、权限遗漏、升级破坏契约；需逐项验证。Possible difficulties include unavailable source/interfaces, unreproducible states, access gaps and upgrade breaks; verify each one.

讨论Discussion首个低风险用户和业务专家是谁？哪一类失败触发缩小范围或转交 DT？Who is the first low-risk user and business expert? Which failure triggers scope reduction or DT handoff?

组织与价值证据：没有基线，就没有收益结论Organisation and value evidence: no baseline, no value claim

职责可以协作，但不能模糊；验收要同时覆盖业务、工程、接口、安全和维护边界。Responsibilities can be shared, but not blurred; acceptance covers business, engineering, interface, security and maintenance boundaries.

ISS 对标：先填差距，再决定迁移ISS benchmark: map gaps before deciding migration

对标不是宣布已有能力，而是把软件、知识、数据、接口和组织的缺口变成会中可回答的问题。Benchmarking does not declare capability; it turns software, knowledge, data, interface and organisation gaps into answerable questions.

差距地图Gap map

维度Dimension先确认什么First confirm
软件/源码Software/source版本、源码、组件和权限范围Version, source, components and access scope

会中直接提问并确认Ask and confirm in the room

  • Q1 哪一个 ISS 页面痛点明确且可拿到源码与本地环境？Which ISS page has a clear pain and accessible source and local environment?
  • Q2 最低授权范围、数据批准人和字段 Owner 是谁？What is the minimum access, data approver and field Owner?
  • Q3 哪些 Action 只能模拟或必须人确认？Which Actions must be simulated or human-confirmed?
  • Q4 业务验收、代码审核、发布、运营和回滚分别由谁负责？Who owns acceptance, code review, release, operations and rollback?

现场确认：Owner 由会中指定；版本/环境由会中记录；证据位置由会中登记。Confirm live: assign the Owner in the room; record the version/environment; register the evidence location.

018 · MD §D1.2.2.6 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.6DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.2.6

思考：业务规则变更，要留下可复用的证据链Reflection: business-rule change needs a reusable evidence chain

动态表单不是一次性生成物；真正可迁移的是授权、审核、回归、发布与维护的共同语言。A dynamic form is not a one-off artifact; the reusable asset is shared language for access, review, regression, release and maintenance.

01 · CHANGE CHAIN

业务变更链Change chain

  • 业务提规则Business proposes the rule
  • 专家审核→FDE 改Expert review → FDE changes
  • 回归→验收→发布/回滚Regression → acceptance → release/rollback

每一步保存版本、责任、证据和未决项。Keep version, owner, evidence and open items at every step.

02 · KNOWLEDGE

可沉淀资产Reusable assets

  • 字段/状态/权限、接口约定、Action 白名单Fields/states/access, interface conventions and Action allowlist
  • 错误与接管规则、脱敏要求、测试用例Error/takeover rules, redaction and test cases
  • 发布/回滚 SOP、失败样本、缺陷分级Release/rollback SOP, failures and defect severity
03 · REUSE

第二场景：复用与重验证Second scene: reuse and revalidate

  • 复用：需求模板、检查清单、版本/回滚框架。Reuse: need template, checklists and version/rollback frame.
  • 重验：对象语义、状态机、接口、权限、数据敏感性。Revalidate: object meaning, state machine, interfaces, access and sensitivity.
  • 首个页面通过，不推断所有 WMS 能力通过。One passing page does not prove all WMS capability.

现场不追求强行产品化；要产出能力卡、映射、用例和责任，并保留失败时的缩小、停止与转交机制。The room need not force productisation; it should produce a capability card, mappings, tests and owners, with stop, narrow and handoff paths.

  • 授权/范围 → 代码/字段/权限/接口盘点Access/scope → code/field/access/interface inventory
  • 本地环境 → 页面生成 → 校验/错误/ActionLocal environment → page generation → validation/errors/Actions
  • 审核 → 功能/接口测试 → 发布、观测、维护或回滚Review → functional/interface tests → release, observe, maintain or roll back
CAPABILITY CARD场景、输入、输出、边界Scene, input, output, boundary
FIELD MAP字段、状态、权限、接口Fields, states, access, interfaces
ACCEPTANCE最小用例与责任Minimum tests and owners
FAILURE LOG失败、回滚、转交Failure, rollback, handoff

现场修改一个低风险规则Change one low-risk rule live

  • 建议：新增“异常类型”待审核选项，或将“处理建议”设为必填。Suggested: add a review-pending exception type or make recommendation required.
  • 若无真实代码/接口：用脱敏或模拟数据展示草稿，并标注未完成真实回写。If real code/interfaces are unavailable: use redacted or simulated data and mark write-back as uncompleted.
  • 失败时：只读/模拟、回到上一版本、转交 ISS Biz 与 DT/安全审核。On failure: read-only/simulate, revert to the prior version, or hand off to ISS Biz and DT/security.

待补：实际修改内容、参与人、测试结果、目标环境、维护 Owner。To add: actual change, participants, test result, target environment and maintenance Owner.

DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.1 · UNIS Rate & QuoteDAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.1 · UNIS Rate & Quote

先把业务痛点拍清，再定义要验证的结果Make the pain visible before defining the result to validate

业务说费率、报价与运输条件；开发看到系统、表格与字段。第一步不是宣称收益，而是对齐语义、交接与授权边界。Business speaks in rates, quotes and transport conditions; development sees systems, tables and fields. First align semantics, handoffs and access—not claimed benefits.

改造前：反复解释，定义可能分叉Before: repeated explanation, diverging definitions

业务需求Business need

客户、服务、运输、费率、报价、条件。Customer, service, transport, rate, quote, conditions.

→

系统与字段Systems and fields

具体系统、交接人、审批节点、耗时和失败点：待 ISS Biz (team) 补证。Specific systems, handoffs, approval nodes, effort and failure points: ISS Biz (team) to provide.

期望结果＋预录视频位置Target result + pre-recorded video slot

  • 授权数据提出候选，业务专家确认语义。

  • 缺失条件、异常报价交给人；建议与正式报价分开授权。
  • Authorised data proposes candidates; business experts confirm meaning.

  • Missing conditions and exceptions go to people; suggestion and formal quote stay separately authorised.

建议录：真实数据（已授权）→候选→专家审核→页面→表单→规则同步→人工接管。请标注真实 / 脱敏 / 模拟。Record: authorised data → candidates → expert review → page → form → rule sync → human handoff. Label real / redacted / simulated.

021 · MD §D1.2.3.2 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.2 · 闭环建议DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.2 · Proposed closed loop

同一本体贯穿建议、接管与状态回写One ontology links recommendation, takeover and state write-back

正常任务可走页面与表单；缺失信息、规则冲突和异常报价必须显式停下并交给人。Normal work can use the page and form; missing data, rule conflicts and abnormal quotes must stop visibly and go to a person.

正常任务Normal task

  • 输入客户、服务、运输条件、费率、报价条件、有效期。
  • 分析页面展示口径、条件影响、来源与缺失信息。
  • 表单做字段校验并生成报价建议。
  • Enter customer, service, transport conditions, rate, quote conditions and validity.
  • Analysis shows definition, condition impact, source and missing data.
  • The form validates fields and produces a quote suggestion.

缺失与异常Missing data and exceptions

  • 必需条件缺失：标缺口，停止自动推进。
  • 规则冲突、超期、计算差异：保留输入与规则版本。
  • 无法解释的异常报价：进入人工判断。
  • Required data missing: flag the gap and stop automatic progress.
  • Rule conflict, expiry or calculation difference: retain input and rule versions.
  • Unexplainable abnormal quote: route to human judgement.

确认、回写与结果Confirm, write back and result

HUMAN GATE专家确认语义与例外；授权人员确认建议；正式报价按既定审批。Experts confirm meaning and exceptions; authorised staff confirm suggestions; formal quotes follow existing approval.
STATE建议状态：草稿／待补信息／待审核／待授权／已确认／退回或停止。Suggested states: draft / missing data / review / authorisation / confirmed / returned or stopped.
WRITE-BACK使用与业务结果反向更新本体与规则；目标系统与结果定义待补。Usage and business results feed back to ontology and rules; target system and result definition are pending.
讨论焦点Discussion哪些状态已经存在？哪条边界必须阻止自动推进？正式报价由谁授权？Which states already exist? Which boundary must stop automation? Who authorises a formal quote?

022 · MD §D1.2.3.3 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.3 · 实施过程与采用DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.3 · Build, adoption and iteration

从授权数据到可回放的小范围验证From authorised data to a replayable bounded validation

先锁定边界和证据，再建设页面与表单；未知阻力标成可能困难，不写成历史事实。Lock scope and evidence before building pages and forms; possible difficulties are hypotheses, not historical facts.

01 · INPUT

输入与候选Inputs and candidates

  • 授权真实数据、字段说明、现有报价材料。
  • 识别对象、字段、关联、状态与来源版本。
  • Authorised data, field notes and quote material.
  • Identify objects, fields, relations, states and source version.
02 · REVIEW

专家审核Expert review

  • 确认条件、有效期、例外、计算与决策边界。
  • 记录确认人、版本、生效范围。
  • Confirm conditions, validity, exceptions, calculation and decision boundaries.
  • Record reviewer, version and effective scope.
03 · BUILD

页面与表单Page and form

  • 同一本体生成分析页面、字段校验和受控 Action。
  • 正常、缺失、冲突、异常样本回放。
  • Generate analysis, validation and controlled Actions from one ontology.
  • Replay normal, missing, conflicting and abnormal samples.
04 · ADOPT

采用与迭代Adopt and iterate

  • 业务专家和一线使用者用受控真实样本验收。
  • 按反馈补条件、异常、样本；必要时缩小或停止。
  • Experts and frontline users accept with controlled real samples.
  • Add conditions, exceptions and samples; narrow or stop when needed.

可能困难（待验证）Possible difficulties (to verify)

字段缺少业务语义、来源口径不一致、例外未覆盖、页面与表单定义分叉、权限或接口不清晰。Missing business meaning, inconsistent sources, uncovered exceptions, diverging page/form definitions, unclear access or interfaces.

建议机制：候选/确认分层、异常集、版本溯源、规则回归、正式报价权限门。Suggested controls: candidate/confirmed layers, exception set, version trace, rule regression and formal-quote gate.

讨论焦点Discussion首个小范围的输入、审核人和可回放样本由谁锁定？Who locks the first bounded scope’s inputs, reviewers and replayable samples?

DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.4 · 组织与价值证据DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.4 · Roles and value evidence

把职责和证据先写清，不虚构 KPIWrite ownership and evidence first; do not invent KPIs

组织分工是建议设计；验收要有分母、周期、错误级别和可回放证据。当前没有已实现运营结果。Roles are a proposed design; acceptance needs denominators, periods, error levels and replayable evidence. No achieved operating result is available here.

建议职责边界Suggested ownership

参与方Party职责Role
ISS Biz (team)场景、规则、数据定义、专家确认、验收与价值验证。Scenario, rules, data definition, expert review, acceptance and value.
ITEM与 COO AI Team/Hollis 紧密共同开发；实现页面、表单、测试和交付。Co-build closely with COO AI Team/Hollis; implement pages, forms, tests and delivery.
COO AI Team / DT已有成果与方法支撑；数据、代码、软件、接口等按需支撑。Existing results and method support; data, code, software and interfaces as needed.

审批、运营维护和正式报价 Owner：待确认。Approval, operations and formal-quote Owner: to be confirmed.

验收基线与待补结果Acceptance baseline and missing results

  • 分母：预先锁定的样本集与业务边界。
  • 周期：约定回放/运营周期。
  • 观察：概念一致、必填完整、来源可追溯、计算差异、异常升级、接管记录、页面/表单一致。
  • 错误级别：语义、规则/计算、权限/流程、数据质量、结果记录。
  • Denominator: locked sample set and business boundary.
  • Period: agreed replay/operations period.
  • Observe: semantic consistency, completeness, traceability, calculation gaps, escalation, takeover and page/form alignment.
  • Error levels: semantic, rule/calculation, access/process, data quality and result-record errors.

待补证据Evidence needed

样本量、基线、各类错误数、人工时长/成本、接管率、回滚次数、正式报价通过/退回情况。Sample size, baseline, error counts, effort/cost, takeover rate, rollbacks and formal-quote approvals/returns.

对标差距要落到具体问题与 OwnerBenchmark gaps must land on questions and Owners

已知现状是业务与开发围绕报价、费率和条件反复沟通；其余系统、权限、接口与运营事实需在会中填写。Known today: business and development repeatedly align on rates, quotes and conditions. Systems, access, interfaces and operations must be filled in live.

对标四个差距面Four gap surfaces

KNOWLEDGE字段、规则、例外、有效期与计算含义是否有审核记录？Are meanings of fields, rules, exceptions, validity and calculation reviewed?
DATA授权样本、来源版本、质量与脱敏方式是什么？What are the authorised samples, source version, quality and redaction?
INTERFACE分析页面、表单、状态回写和正式报价权限在哪里？Where are the analysis page, form, state write-back and formal-quote access?

现场填写与迁移边界Live capture and transfer boundary

  • 最小可复现报价样本：`[ISS Biz (team) 填写]`
  • 歧义字段与业务专家：`[ISS Biz (team) 填写]`

  • 最佳实践可迁移证据：`[COO AI Team/ITEM/ISS Biz 填写]`

025 · MD §D1.2.3.6 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.6 · 变更链与知识沉淀DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.6 · Change chain and knowledge

规则变化必须走审核、回归、发布与回滚Rule changes need review, regression, release and rollback

把业务知识沉淀为可授权、可审核、可回放的资产；第二场景复用机制，不复用未经验证的语义。Turn business knowledge into authorised, reviewable and replayable assets; reuse mechanisms, not unverified semantics.

业务变更链Business change chain

01 · BUSINESS业务提出费率、报价条件或例外变更。Business proposes a rate, quote-condition or exception change.
02 · EXPERT专家审核含义、边界、生效范围。Expert reviews meaning, boundaries and effective scope.
03 · FDE / ITEM修改本体、规则、页面或表单。FDE / ITEM changes ontology, rule, page or form.
04 · GATE回归 → 业务验收 → 按权限发布或回滚 → 运营回写。Regression → business acceptance → authorised release or rollback → operations write-back.

可沉淀与需重验证Reuse versus re-validate

  • 可沉淀：审核定义、异常样本、版本溯源、字段校验、权限门、评测集、回滚和运营机制。
  • 需重验证：客户/服务/运输/费率语义、接口、权限、计算条件、例外和正式报价边界。
  • 第二场景：不因都使用本体就视为同一应用。
  • Reuse: reviewed definitions, exception samples, traceability, validation, access gates, evals, rollback and operations.
  • Re-validate: customer/service/transport/rate semantics, interfaces, access, calculations, exceptions and formal-quote boundary.
  • Second scene: ontology use alone does not make one application.

具体工具、系统和知识库位置：待补。Specific tools, systems and knowledge-base location: pending.

讨论焦点Discussion谁可以提出变更？谁审核？回归样本和回滚门在哪里？Who may propose a change? Who reviews it? Where are regression samples and rollback gates?

026 · MD §D1.2.3.7 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.7 · 可重复交付与动手DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.3.7 · Repeatable delivery and hands-on

现场把一条规则改完，并留下可验收草稿Change one rule live and leave an acceptance-ready draft

通用方法可以复用，业务语义必须重验证；动手目标是小范围草稿，不是宣称上线或正式报价成功。The method can repeat, but business semantics must be re-validated. The hands-on output is a bounded draft, not a production or formal-quote claim.

可重复交付链Repeatable delivery chain

01 · SCOPE授权数据与边界Authorised data and scope
02 · MODEL候选 → 审核 → 本体/规则Candidate → review → ontology/rule
03 · BUILD页面 → 表单 → 校验Page → form → validation
04 · PROVE正常/异常回放 → 人确认Normal/exception replay → human confirmation
05 · OPERATE验收 → 发布/回滚 → 反馈Acceptance → release/rollback → feedback

通用核心：审核、版本、溯源、异常分流、权限门、评测与维护。Common core: review, versioning, traceability, exception routing, access gates, evaluation and maintenance.

现场动手与停止机制Hands-on and stop rules

  • ISS Biz (team) 提供一条已授权、可脱敏的最小报价样本。
  • 修改一条业务规则/报价条件，展示本体定义、分析口径、表单校验、异常路径和权限门。
  • 产出：能力卡、小范围验收表、责任字段草稿。
  • 语义无法确认、样本不足、接口/权限不清或无法安全接管：缩小、转人工、暂停或停止。
  • ISS Biz (team) provides one authorised, redacted minimum quote sample.
  • Change one rule/quote condition; show ontology, analysis definition, form validation, exception path and access gate.
  • Output: capability card, bounded acceptance sheet and ownership fields.
  • If meaning, samples, interfaces, access or safe takeover fail: narrow, hand off, pause or stop.

027 · MD §D1.2.4.1 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.1

ISS BO：从“订单在哪里”到“下一步怎么做”ISS BO: From “where is the order?” to “what happens next?”

先锁定一条可验收的 BO / Customer Promise 链，再把规则、交接和证据放进同一个闭环。Start with one testable BO / Customer Promise chain, then connect rules, handoffs, and evidence in one loop.

业务痛点与期望结果Pain and intended outcome

  • 规则随业务线、地区、服务承诺、料件、库存、物流状态变化；单一 Prompt 难以覆盖合理例外。Rules vary by line, region, promise, part, inventory, and logistics; one prompt cannot cover valid exceptions.
  • 建议结果：解释为什么延迟、什么时候完成、下一步怎么做，并保留证据与人工边界。Intended outcome: explain delay, estimate completion, and propose next action with evidence and human boundaries.

改造前待核实：查WIKI → 跨系统核对 → 专家判断 → 客户承诺 → 人工回写。标出重复查询、交接与延迟。Before, to verify: WIKI lookup → cross-system checks → expert judgment → customer promise → manual write-back. Identify repeated checks and handoffs.

范围建议：先选择有限业务线、地区、料件与服务承诺组合；不把全组织覆盖写成已完成。Scope: choose limited lines, regions, parts and promises; enterprise-wide coverage is not claimed.

预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：一条 BO / Customer Promise 链，从 WIKI 规则、跨系统查询、ETA/风险判断到专家确认与状态回写。Suggested recording: one BO / Customer Promise chain, from a WIKI rule and cross-system query through ETA/risk review, expert confirmation, and status write-back.

请区分：真实业务、脱敏演示、模拟流程；本槽位不含 src，不代表已有结果。Label it as real, anonymized, or simulated; this slot has no src and does not imply an achieved result.

讨论Discussion本轮先覆盖哪些规则？当前流程中最慢的交接在哪里？Which rules come first, and where is the slowest handoff today?

028 · MD §D1.2.4.2 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.2

改造后闭环：回答、判断、接管、回写Future loop: answer, decide, hand over, write back

建议把“可回答”与“可执行”拆开：先给出可追溯判断，再按风险和权限决定是否放行。Separate “answerable” from “executable”: give a traceable judgment first, then gate action by risk and authority.

01 · 建议路径01 · Suggested path

正常任务Normal task

  • 读取订单、料件、库存、替代件、物流与 ETA 信息。Read order, part, inventory, substitute, logistics, and ETA data.
  • 输出延迟原因、预计完成时间、候选方案与下一步 Action。Return delay reason, ETA, options, and next Action.
  • 保留知识/规则版本与证据来源。Keep knowledge/rule version and evidence sources.
02 · 建议路径02 · Suggested path

缺失信息与异常Missing data and exceptions

  • 字段缺失、规则冲突、超范围或高风险时，返回缺口与待确认项，不猜测。For missing fields, conflicts, out-of-scope, or high risk, return gaps and questions; do not guess.
  • 进入人工队列，标记失败类型与影响范围。Route to a human queue with failure type and impact.
  • 复杂预测/优化仅按实际可接入范围调用。Use advanced prediction/optimization only where actually connected.
03 · 人确认＋状态回写03 · Human approval + write-back

放行边界Release boundary

  • ISS Biz 专家确认规则、结果与可接受动作。ISS Biz experts confirm rules, results, and acceptable actions.
  • 确认后回写结果、证据、版本、审批人与执行状态。After approval, write back result, evidence, version, approver, and execution status.
  • 失败/超时回人工；不把完整跨组织接通写成已完成。On failure/timeout, return to humans; do not claim full cross-organization integration.
讨论Discussion哪类 Action 必须审批？哪些状态字段需要保留审计记录？Which Actions require approval, and which status fields need an audit trail?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.4.2
029 · MD §D1.2.4.3 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.3

实施不是“接一个模型”：FDE 把知识变成可运行闭环Implementation is more than calling a model: FDE makes knowledge runnable

按版本、样本、专家审核和独立评测推进；困难先作为风险管理，不把未证实阻力写成历史事实。Work through versions, samples, expert review, and independent evaluation; treat unverified obstacles as risks, not history.

建议实施链Suggested build chain

  1. 从 WIKI/已有知识确定范围、主要规则与当前版本。Set scope, key rules, and current version from WIKI and existing knowledge.
  2. 建立小本体，补齐正常、例外、缺失和边界样本。Build a small ontology and add normal, exception, missing, and boundary samples.
  3. 专家确认规则、结果和可接受动作。Experts confirm rules, results, and acceptable actions.
  4. 独立评测拆分回答、规则判断、预测、建议和 Action。Independently evaluate answers, rule judgments, forecasts, recommendations, and Actions.

可能困难与克服机制Possible difficulties and countermeasures

  • 术语/版本不一致 → 版本化词表与审核记录。Term/version inconsistency → versioned glossary and review log.
  • 字段缺失或例外难枚举 → 字段契约、分层样本与风险分级。Missing fields or hard-to-enumerate exceptions → field contract, stratified samples, risk tiers.
  • 专家时间有限 → 短时审核、待确认队列与截止时间。Limited expert time → short reviews, a question queue, and deadlines.
  • 调试样本混入评测集 → 训练/调试与独立评测严格分开。Debug samples leaking into evaluation → strict separation.

采用建议：现场演示一条可追踪链，让专家先改一个规则或边界样本，再形成责任人和回归项。Adoption suggestion: demo one traceable chain; let an expert change one rule or boundary sample, then assign an owner and regression item.

讨论Discussion哪一类错误应返回知识、规则、样本、本体、接口，还是运营流程？Which errors should go back to knowledge, rules, samples, ontology, interfaces, or operations?

030 · MD §D1.2.4.4 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.4

组织与价值证据：把 90% 放回正确分母Organization and value evidence: put 90% on the right denominator

职责可以先建议，结果必须后验收；回答、规则判断、ETA、建议与 Action 分开报告。Responsibilities can be proposed; results must be evidenced. Report answers, rule judgments, ETA, recommendations, and Actions separately.

责任与运营Responsibilities and operations

  • Tom 主持；ITEM 对接 COO AI Team / Hollis；ISS Biz (team) 负责业务规则与验收；DT 按需支撑数据、代码、软件、接口和跨部门。Tom facilitates; ITEM connects COO AI Team / Hollis; ISS Biz (team) owns rules and acceptance; DT supports data, code, software, interfaces, and cross-team work as needed.
  • FDE 连接知识、例外、样本、系统能力与可运行应用，不替代业务 Owner。FDE connects knowledge, exceptions, samples, systems, and runnable applications; it does not replace the business Owner.
  • 建议明确本体、样本、评测、发布、回滚与异常队列的维护人。Assign maintainers for ontology, samples, evaluation, release, rollback, and exception queues.

验收与 90%口径Acceptance and the 90% metric

  • 绑定任务、场景、版本、样本来源、专家口径与失败分布。Bind it to task, scenario, version, sample source, expert rubric, and failure distribution.
  • 尚无完整评测时，只标为验证目标，不写成整体上线结果。If evaluation is incomplete, label it a target, not an overall production result.
  • 高风险错误单列；权限、风险和人工确认决定能否执行。Report high-risk errors separately; authority, risk, and human approval gate execution.
  • 训练/调试样本与独立评测集分开；合成样本标注来源。Separate training/debug samples from independent evaluation; label synthetic sources.

待补：正确案例数/有效评测案例数、周期、基线、成本、人工介入与错误等级。To fill: correct/valid cases, period, baseline, cost, human intervention, and error levels.

讨论Discussion90%具体衡量什么？高风险错误的放行阈值和 Owner 是谁？What exactly does 90% measure? Who owns the release threshold for high-risk errors?

031 · MD §D1.2.4.5 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.5

ISS 对标：把未知差距变成会中可填的问题ISS benchmark: turn unknown gaps into questions to fill live

已知方法主线是 WIKI → 小本体 → 样本＋专家审核 → 评测 → 泛化；现状、接口和运营数据仍需现场确认。The known method is WIKI → small ontology → samples plus expert review → evaluation → generalization; current gaps need live confirmation.

对标基线Benchmark baseline

现状Current规则分散于 WIKI、专家判断与跨系统查询；具体节点、周期未知。Rules span WIKI, expert judgment, and cross-system queries; nodes and cycle time unknown.
最好实践Best practice小范围本体与独立评测，错误返回知识/规则/样本/本体。Small-scope ontology and independent evaluation; route errors back to knowledge/rules/samples/ontology.
知识/数据Knowledge/data必要概念已列；字段、版本、来源与样本分布未知。Core concepts are listed; fields, versions, sources, and sample mix unknown.
接口/组织Interfaces/org需要按权限查询并回写；实际系统、Owner、审批链未知。Permissioned query and write-back are needed; systems, owners, and approval chain unknown.

会中具体追问Questions to answer live

  1. 当前端到端流程、平均周期、重复查询和交接点是什么？What are the end-to-end flow, average cycle, repeat queries, and handoffs?
  2. 哪一条 ISS 最好实践可复用？哪一条必须重验证？Which ISS best practice can be reused, and which needs revalidation?
  3. 哪些字段可读/可写？哪些 Action 必须人工审批？Which fields are readable/writable, and which Actions need human approval?
  4. 谁维护本体、样本、评测、发布、回滚和异常队列？Who maintains ontology, samples, evaluation, release, rollback, and exception queues?
会中待确认：业务线｜系统｜Owner｜周期｜差距Confirm live: line | systems | Owner | cycle | gap

032 · MD §D1.2.4.6 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.6

思考：业务变更链，才是可持续泛化的边界Reflection: the change chain defines sustainable generalization

复用的是治理与交付方法，不是把一个小本体的结果直接外推到全部 BO。Reuse the delivery and governance method, not the result of one small ontology across all BO.

建议变更链Suggested change chain

  1. 业务提出规则/服务承诺变化Business proposes a rule or service-promise change
  2. ISS Biz 专家审核授权ISS Biz expert reviews and authorizes
  3. FDE 修改知识、本体、规则与样本FDE changes knowledge, ontology, rules, and samples
  4. 独立回归评测，复核风险与权限Independent regression; recheck risk and authority
  5. 发布；失败则回滚或转人工Release; roll back or hand over if it fails

可沉淀与必须重验证What to retain and revalidate

  • 可沉淀：授权术语、规则与例外、流程、Skill、评测集、错误分类、运营 SLA、审计字段、发布/回滚机制。Retain: authorized terms, rules, exceptions, processes, Skills, evaluation sets, error taxonomy, SLAs, audit fields, release/rollback.
  • 第二场景复用：本体骨架、样本分层、专家模板、评测拆分、风险分级、责任矩阵。Reuse: ontology skeleton, sample stratification, expert template, evaluation split, risk tiers, responsibility matrix.
  • 必须重验证：术语、服务承诺、地区规则、料件/库存/物流字段、接口权限、样本分布、高风险动作。Revalidate: terms, promises, regional rules, part/inventory/logistics fields, interface authority, sample mix, high-risk Actions.
记录：每次变更保留版本、样本来源、评测结果、审批人与生效范围。Record: version, sample source, evaluation result, approver, and effective scope for every change.
讨论Discussion谁有权授权知识进入核心库？第二场景最需要重验证哪一项？Who authorizes knowledge into the core library? What needs the strongest revalidation in scenario two?

033 · MD §D1.2.4.7 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.4.7

可重复交付＋动手：从一条规则产出能力卡Repeatable delivery + hands-on: turn one rule into a capability card

现场不追求一次产品化；完成一个小范围、可审计、可回滚的草稿，并明确下一步责任。Do not force productization today; produce a small, auditable, reversible draft with clear ownership.

可重复交付包Repeatable delivery package

  • 范围与术语卡；小本体与字段契约。Scope and glossary card; small ontology and field contract.
  • 正常/例外/缺失/边界样本包；专家审核记录。Normal/exception/missing/boundary samples; expert review log.
  • 独立评测集与任务口径；接口、权限、人工接管和状态回写说明。Independent evaluation and task definitions; interface, authority, handover, and write-back notes.
  • 运营看板、错误分级、发布/回滚和责任矩阵。Operations view, error tiers, release/rollback, and responsibility matrix.

现场动手与停止条件Hands-on and stop conditions

动作建议：用授权材料修改一个规则或流程；例如把“ETA 缺失”例外加入样本，写出人工接管、验收项、责任人和回滚点。Suggested action: modify one authorized rule or flow; for example, add an “ETA missing” exception with handover, acceptance, owner, and rollback point.

产出：小范围草稿＋能力卡＋验收表＋责任矩阵；记录版本、专家确认与评测影响。Output: small-scope draft, capability card, acceptance sheet, responsibility matrix; record version, expert approval, and evaluation impact.

失败机制：本体失效、字段不可得、独立评测不通过或高风险错误未关闭 → 缩小范围、暂停自动 Action、转 ISS Biz 专家/人工队列。Failure mechanism: ontology failure, unavailable fields, failed evaluation, or open high-risk errors → narrow scope, pause automatic Actions, and hand over to ISS Biz experts/humans.

讨论Discussion今天现场要修改哪条规则？谁签字验收，什么条件触发停止？Which rule will we change today? Who signs acceptance, and what triggers a stop?

034 · MD §D1.2.5.1 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.1DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.1

从“做得出来”开始采集知识Capture Knowledge from Work People Can Demonstrate

先把真实操作变成可审核的 SOP 草稿，再决定哪些步骤适合 Agent、Tool 或 Workflow；不是先假设自动化已经成功。Turn demonstrated work into a reviewable SOP draft before deciding what belongs in an Agent, Tool, or Workflow. Do not assume automation success.

业务痛点 · 已知BUSINESS PAIN · KNOWN

文字 SOP 先行，容易漏掉真实动作Text-first SOPs miss real actions

页面切换、口头判断、手工步骤和未记录经验难以仅靠访谈还原。候选适用流程包括 backlog、物流数据、线下资料与跨系统操作。Screen changes, verbal judgement, manual steps, and tacit experience are easy to miss in interviews. Candidate flows include backlog, logistics data, offline materials, and cross-system work.

期望结果 · 建议EXPECTED OUTCOME · PROPOSED

有证据的草稿 + 清晰的接管边界Evidence-backed draft + clear takeover boundaries

输出步骤、输入、判断、系统切换、例外、结果和不确定性；由实际操作人员及 ISS Biz (team) 业务 Owner 审核。耗时、遗漏、修正量和维护成本待实测。Output steps, inputs, decisions, system changes, exceptions, results, and uncertainty. The operator and ISS Biz (team) Owner review it. Time, omissions, corrections, and maintenance cost are unmeasured.

预录视频｜待 Tom 放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：一个低风险、可复现的真实操作，保留必要背景、角色、页面切换、判断和至少一个异常；明确标注“真实 / 脱敏 / 模拟”。此处不写假 src，用户后续替换为播放器。Suggested recording: one low-risk, reproducible operation with context, role, screen changes, decisions, and at least one exception. Label it “real / de-identified / simulated.” No fake src is included; the user can replace this slot with a player.

改造前：业务示范或回忆 → 文字/访谈 → 专家澄清 → 技术判断 → 交接 → 验收。Before: demonstration or recall → notes/interview → expert clarification → automation judgement → handoff → acceptance.

DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.2DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.2

闭环不是“自动完成”：它必须可暂停、可回写A Closed Loop Must Pause and Write Back

从视频到 SOP，再到受控执行；任何证据不足、权限不明或不可逆动作都触发人工确认。From video to SOP to controlled execution; insufficient evidence, unclear permission, or irreversible actions trigger human confirmation.

01
已知路径 + 建议输入KNOWN PATH + PROPOSED INPUT

采集与提取Capture and extract

  • 授权录制或导入可共享视频。Record with authorization or import a shareable video.
  • 提取顺序、输入、判断、切换、人工动作、例外、结果。Extract order, inputs, decisions, changes, manual actions, exceptions, and results.
  • 无法证明的条件保留为“不确定”，不猜补。Keep unproven conditions as “uncertain”; do not guess.
02
建议闭环PROPOSED LOOP

问清楚与接管Clarify and take over

  • 缺字段、画面不可读、权限不明或异常时，生成问题清单并暂停。Pause and create a question list when fields are missing, screens unreadable, permissions unclear, or exceptions appear.
  • 实际操作人员与 ISS Biz (team) Owner 审核步骤。The operator and ISS Biz (team) Owner review each step.
  • 跨系统提交、敏感数据和不可逆动作要求人确认。Human confirmation is required for cross-system submission, sensitive data, and irreversible actions.
03
验证边界 · 待补结果VALIDATION BOUNDARY · RESULTS PENDING

受控执行与回写Controlled run and write-back

  • 先在沙盒跑正常与异常路径，再按最小权限执行。Run normal and exception paths in a sandbox, then execute with least privilege.
  • 回写状态、规则版本、人工修正、失败原因和最终结果。Write back status, rule version, corrections, failure reason, and final result.
  • 当前没有成功率、自动化比例或收益数据；不得补造。No success rate, automation ratio, or benefit data is provided; do not fabricate it.

对标不靠猜：把 ISS 的差距现场填出来Benchmark Without Guessing: Fill ISS Gaps Live

输入没有说明 ISS 现有最好实践；本页把未知项变成会中可验证的问题和证据位置。The input does not identify an existing ISS best practice; this page turns unknowns into verifiable questions and evidence slots.

五类差距核对Five gap checks

  • 知识：视频能否关联步骤、来源和不确定性？Knowledge: can video link to steps, sources, and uncertainty?
  • 数据：脱敏、字段、访问和留存是否可证明？Data: can de-identification, fields, access, and retention be evidenced?
  • 接口：跨系统读写、状态回写和回滚是否存在？Interfaces: do cross-system read/write, write-back, and rollback exist?
  • 组织：Owner、专家审核、运营、接管责任是否明确？Organization: are Owner, expert review, operations, and takeover clear?
  • 评测：基线、样本、错误级别、回归和发布门槛是什么？Evaluation: what are baseline, samples, severity, regression, and release gates?

会中填写位置Live fill-in prompts

演示：Demo: 谁提供、谁审核、谁替代？【待填】Who provides, reviews, and substitutes? [Fill in]

数据：Data: 真实/脱敏/模拟、分级、审批人？【待填】Real/de-identified/simulated, classification, approver? [Fill in]

接管：Takeover: 什么情况暂停？谁处理？【待填】What pauses the run? Who handles it? [Fill in]

证据：Evidence: 基线、分母、周期、错误级别、链接？【待填】Baseline, denominator, period, severity, link? [Fill in]

039 · MD §D1.2.5.6 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.6DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.6

让规则可变更、可回归、可回滚Make Rules Changeable, Regression-Tested, and Reversible

业务规则由业务提出，专家审核，FDE 改造，回归后再发布；知识资产必须带授权与审核记录。Business proposes rules, experts review, FDE changes, regression follows, then release. Knowledge assets need authorization and review records.

建议业务变更链Proposed change chain

1

业务提出规则/流程变更Business proposes rule/process change

记录提出人、范围、原因Record proposer, scope, and reason

2

专家与实际操作人员审核Expert and operator review

确认例外、权限、接管边界Confirm exceptions, permissions, takeover

3

ITEM / COO AI Team/Hollis 开发，DT 按需支撑ITEM / COO AI Team/Hollis build; DT supports as needed

保留版本与影响范围Keep version and impact scope

4

正常/异常回归 → ISS Biz (team) 验收 → 发布/回滚Normal/exception regression → ISS Biz (team) acceptance → release/rollback

监控失败、修正和停止条件Monitor failures, corrections, stop conditions

可沉淀资产与重验证项Reusable assets and revalidation

可复用Reuse

采集模板、证据结构、缺失信息问法、接管协议、版本/回滚字段、沙盒回归、验收与运营复盘。Capture template, evidence structure, missing-info questions, takeover protocol, version/rollback fields, sandbox regression, acceptance, and operations review.

必须重验证Revalidate

新场景的授权、敏感数据、接口、字段语义、业务规则、异常分布、权限和最终结果定义。New scenario authorization, sensitive data, interfaces, field semantics, business rules, exception distribution, permissions, and final-result definition.

不可默认Do not assume

能录屏不等于 Agent 能直接迁移；原始视频也不等于应长期保存。Recordability does not imply direct Agent transfer; raw video does not imply long-term retention.

讨论Discussion谁能批准规则进入回归？什么证据允许发布，什么情况必须回滚？Who approves a rule for regression? What evidence allows release, and what forces rollback?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.5.6
040 · MD §D1.2.5.7 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.7DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.5.7

可重复交付，先从一次安全动手开始Repeatable Delivery Starts with One Safe Hands-on Test

把方法拆成核心、配置、接口、评测和维护；现场只修改一个低风险规则或流程分支。Separate the method into core, configuration, interfaces, evaluation, and maintenance. Modify one low-risk rule or branch live.

通用交付 11 步11-step delivery pattern

  1. 筛选边界清楚、可复现的流程。Select a bounded, reproducible flow.
  2. 确认授权、数据、留存与停止条件。Confirm authorization, data, retention, and stop conditions.
  3. 录制/导入示例，提取步骤、条件、动作、例外、结果。Record/import and extract steps, conditions, actions, exceptions, results.
  4. 生成带证据与不确定性标注的 SOP。Generate an SOP with evidence and uncertainty labels.
  5. 业务审核 → 拆分 Agent/Tool/Workflow/人工步骤。Business review → split Agent/Tool/Workflow/manual steps.
  6. 沙盒跑正常/异常 → 受控发布 → 回写 → 回归。Sandbox normal/exception → controlled release → write-back → regression.

现场动手产出Hands-on outputs

选择低风险、可脱敏或模拟步骤，修改一条规则或流程分支，并保留修改前后版本。Choose a low-risk, de-identifiable or simulated step; modify one rule or branch and retain before/after versions.

  • 小范围 SOP 草稿/能力卡Small-scope SOP / capability card
  • 一个正常样本 + 一个异常样本One normal + one exception sample
  • 验收项、接管人、回滚条件Acceptance items, takeover owner, rollback condition
  • 责任人、审核人、版本与下一步Owners, reviewer, version, and next step
缩小/停止机制：证据不足、授权不完整、接口无法安全回写、异常不可控或无法验收时，保留人工、转交或停止；不强行产品化。Narrow/stop: if evidence, authorization, safe write-back, exception control, or acceptance is missing, keep human steps, hand off, or stop; do not force productization.
讨论Discussion现场要改哪一条规则？谁确认它能回归、发布或回滚？Which rule changes live? Who confirms it can regress, release, or roll back?

041 · MD §D1.2.6.1 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.1

从真实坐席流程到可审核的 Genesys 闭环From real agent work to an auditable Genesys loop

先看坐席如何跨知识、订单、服务和沟通系统工作，再决定哪些步骤可自动、需辅助或必须由人决定。Observe how agents work across knowledge, order, service and communication systems before deciding what can be automated, assisted or kept human-led.

痛点与期望结果｜建议Pain and target outcome | Proposed

  • 隐性判断和未文档化步骤，让 IT 难以单独判断自动化价值。Tacit judgement and undocumented steps make automation hard to assess from IT alone.
  • 建议产出：可审核 CEC SOP、首个受控动作、人工接管点和回写证据。Proposed output: an auditable CEC SOP, first controlled Action, human takeover point and write-back evidence.

改造前流程｜待现场确认Before | To confirm on site

  • 坐席接收请求 → 多系统切换 → 依经验查询/补充/回复 → 例外升级。Request → system switching → experience-based query/capture/reply → exception escalation.
  • 待补：任务频次、人工基线、录屏授权、个人信息和留存范围。Missing: task frequency, human baseline, recording consent, personal data and retention scope.

预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：一个坐席任务、跨系统切换、判断分支、标准回复/信息补充、升级点和最终状态。Record: one agent task, system switches, decision branches, standard reply/information capture, escalation and final status.

请区分真实／脱敏／模拟，并标出与实际接口、权限和规则的差异。Label real / redacted / simulated, including differences from live interfaces, access and rules.

此槽位默认无视频 src；由用户后续放置预录内容。No video src by default; the user will place the recording later.

042 · MD §D1.2.6.2 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.2

正常任务、异常与人工接管：闭环先于自动化Normal work, exceptions and takeover: close the loop first

建议把每个动作放进同一条可追溯链：输入、知识、动作、接管、状态回写和最终业务结果。Put every Action on one traceable chain: input, knowledge, Action, takeover, status write-back and final business result.

01

输入与识别Input and identify

识别任务、必要字段和相关知识；范围需经授权。Identify task, required fields and knowledge within authorised scope.

02

正常任务Normal path

SOP → UKM / Ontology / Skill → Connector/Tools；标准后台动作按权限执行。SOP → UKM / Ontology / Skill → Connector/Tools; run standard back-office Actions only within access.

03

缺失信息Missing data

提示缺失字段并请求补充；未满足前不执行完整性要求高的动作。Prompt for missing fields; do not run Actions requiring complete data until satisfied.

04

异常与接管Exception and takeover

冲突、接口失败、敏感沟通或高风险动作转人工；坐席可修正。Conflicts, failures, sensitive communication or high-risk Actions go to an agent for correction.

05

状态回写Write back

记录调用、权限、接管、修正与最终结果；字段待确认。Log calls, access, takeover, corrections and final result; fields to confirm.

06

业务结果Business result

以业务系统可核验状态验收；没有已证实收益数字。Accept against a verifiable business-system state; no proven benefit figures yet.

边界与待补证据Guardrails and missing evidence

  • 保留人的责任：Human accountability: 敏感沟通、例外处理和高风险动作不无头化。keep sensitive communication, exceptions and high-risk Actions human-led.
  • 已知路径：Known path: 授权录屏 → CEC SOP → Agent → Genesys 集成与受控执行。authorised recording → CEC SOP → Agent → controlled Genesys integration.
  • 待补：To confirm: 首个动作、接口、权限、失败码、日志、回写字段和留存。first Action, interface, access, failure codes, logs, write-back fields and retention.

043 · MD §D1.2.6.3 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.3

从被动观察到受控采用：建议的实施路径From passive observation to controlled adoption

先把真实流程转成可审核SOP，再逐步开放知识、建议和允许的后台动作；未证实的阻力只作为可能困难。Turn real work into an auditable SOP first, then open knowledge, suggestions and permitted back-office Actions step by step; unverified resistance remains a possibility.

输入与建设Inputs and build

  • ISS Biz（team）与坐席选一个可授权、可脱敏、可复盘的高频任务。ISS Biz (team) and agents select an authorised, redacted and reviewable frequent task.
  • Tom主持；ITEM对接COO AI Team/Hollis共同开发；DT按需支撑。Tom hosts; ITEM works with COO AI Team/Hollis; DT supports as needed.
  • 逐段标注字段、判断、切换、例外、权限、输出与接管点。Annotate fields, decisions, switches, exceptions, access, outputs and takeover points.

可能困难｜建议机制Possible difficulties | Proposed controls

  • 授权/隐私：Consent/privacy: 先脱敏或模拟，保留差异清单。start redacted or simulated; keep a difference log.
  • 隐性判断：Tacit judgement: 用自动/辅助/人工审核表，勿强行产品化。use an automate/assist/human review sheet; do not force productisation.
  • 接口边界：Interface scope: 先画最小闭环，逐项确认权限、日志、回写。draw the minimum loop and confirm access, logs and write-back item by item.

采用与持续改进Adoption and improvement

  • 先展示建议、来源、缺失字段和接管点，再决定是否受控执行。Show suggestion, source, missing fields and takeover before controlled execution.
  • 每轮只扩大已验证范围；用抽检、版本、权限复核、回归更新知识和规则。Expand only validated scope; use sampling, versioning, access review and regression.
  • 实际采用率、质量、成本和运营结果待测。Adoption, quality, cost and operating results remain to be measured.

建设顺序建议：观察标注 → 专家审核 → UKM/Ontology/Skill → Connector/Tools → 小范围回归 → 受控发布。Suggested order: observe and annotate → expert review → UKM/Ontology/Skill → Connector/Tools → small regression → controlled release.

价值证据从哪里来：职责、验收与度量口径Where value evidence comes from: roles, acceptance and measures

不虚构KPI；先把责任、基线、分母、周期、错误级别和最终结果定义清楚，再收集实测证据。Do not invent KPIs. Define owners, baseline, denominator, period, error severity and final outcome before collecting measurements.

ISS Biz（team）ISS Biz (team)业务Owner、场景选择、规则验收、最终业务结果；具体人待补。Business Owner, scenario choice, rule acceptance and final outcome; named person to confirm.
坐席/专家Agents / experts解释隐性判断、审核SOP、确认例外和人工责任。Explain tacit judgement, review SOP and confirm exceptions and human accountability.
ITEM / COO AI Team / HollisITEM / COO AI Team / Hollis共同开发、复用现有成果、推进受控能力。Co-develop, extend existing results and advance controlled capability.
DT / 接口OwnerDT / interface Owner数据、代码、软件、接口、权限、日志、回写和跨部门支撑。Data, code, software, interfaces, access, logs, write-back and cross-team support.

验收与实测证据Acceptance and measured evidence

  • 基线：时长、切换次数、缺失信息、升级、采纳/修正、错误级别、最终状态。Baseline: time, switches, missing data, escalation, adoption/correction, error severity and final state.
  • 分母/周期：按任务、渠道、队列或班次固定口径；当前为空。Denominator/period: fix by task, channel, queue or shift; currently blank.
  • 质量/成本：正确性、接管、高风险误执行、接口失败、重复工作和运维成本。Quality/cost: correctness, takeover, risky mis-execution, interface failure, rework and operations cost.
  • 验收物：授权材料、版本SOP、动作清单、回归集、日志/回写和责任矩阵。Evidence: authorised material, versioned SOP, Action list, regression set, logs/write-back and RACI.

待补实测：任务量、周期、基线数值、结果、接管率、接口成功/失败、修正量、上线/停止日期。Missing measurements: volume, period, baseline values, outcomes, takeover, interface success/failure, corrections and go/stop date.

047 · MD §D1.2.6.7 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.6.7

可重复交付＋现场动手：小范围、可验收、可停止Repeatable delivery and hands-on: small, testable and stoppable

把观察、审核、动作控制和运营交付做成方法包；证据不足时缩小、暂停或转交，不强行产品化。Package observation, review, Action control and operations; when evidence is weak, narrow, pause or hand over instead of forcing productisation.

六步可重复方法Six repeatable steps

  1. 场景资格：授权、脱敏、边界、Owner、停止条件。Qualify: consent, redaction, scope, Owner and stop condition.
  2. 被动观察：标注步骤、判断、系统、字段、例外和输出。Observe: label steps, decisions, systems, fields, exceptions and outputs.
  3. 能力分级：自动、辅助、人工，并记录依据和风险。Classify: automate, assist or human, with rationale and risk.
  4. 知识与动作：UKM/Ontology/Skill＋最小权限Connector/Tools。Knowledge and Actions: UKM/Ontology/Skill plus least-privilege Connectors/Tools.
  5. 闭环验收：正常、缺失、异常、接管、回写、最终状态。Accept: normal, missing, exception, takeover, write-back and final state.
  6. 运营交付：Owner、版本、日志、抽检、回归、回滚和停止。Operate: Owner, version, logs, sampling, regression, rollback and stop.

通用核心：Core: 授权、标注、审核、分级、日志、回归、责任矩阵。consent, annotation, review, classification, logs, regression and RACI.

场景配置：Config: CEC术语、Genesys动作/字段/权限、回复和升级规则。CEC terms, Genesys Actions/fields/access, replies and escalation rules.

现场动手：一次小范围修改Hands-on: one small change

  • 选一条已授权规则或流程，修改一个步骤或条件。Select one authorised rule or flow and change one step or condition.
  • 产出流程草稿/能力卡：输入、输出、允许/禁止动作、人工接管点。Produce a flow draft/capability card: inputs, outputs, allowed/forbidden Actions and takeover.
  • 补2–3条回归样本、验收口径、责任人和回滚条件。Add 2–3 regression samples, acceptance measure, Owner and rollback condition.
  • 把接口响应、失败、回写和最终状态列为证据字段。Treat response, failure, write-back and final state as evidence fields.

失败机制：Failure mechanism: 不满足授权、质量、安全或接口门槛时，缩小范围、停止或转人工；不能强行产品化。If consent, quality, safety or interface gates fail, narrow, stop or hand over; do not force productisation.

讨论Discussion现场修改哪条规则，才能同时产出能力卡、回归样本和责任人？Which rule should we change live to produce a capability card, regression samples and an Owner?

048 · MD §D1.2.7.1 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.1

ISS CFS＋Depot：先把小流程跑通，再谈快速变更ISS CFS + Depot: Prove one small flow before scaling change

已知痛点是流程小而杂、变化快；本页只提出一个可核验的首个切片，不假定系统已集成。The known pain is fragmented, fast-changing work. Start with one testable slice; do not assume integration.

改造前：交接点比流程图更重要Before: handoffs matter more than a diagram

  • 请求/工单 → 信息补齐 → 任务分派 → 维修/服务执行。Request/work order → information completion → assignment → repair/service.
  • 异常处理 → 完成确认 → 状态回写；逐箭头标出责任、输入、等待、分支和证据。Exception handling → completion → status write-back; mark owner, input, wait, branch and evidence.
  • 期望结果：业务能提出受控变更，运行状态、异常、人工修正和未完成任务可追踪。Desired result: controlled business changes, traceable states, exceptions, manual fixes and unfinished work.
首个切片（待 ISS Biz 确认）First slice (to be confirmed by ISS Biz)
一项低风险维修/服务请求，从接收至完成回写。One low-risk repair/service request, from intake to completion write-back.

预录视频位：展示过程，不替代证据Pre-recorded video slot: show the work, not proof

预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：SOP 到运行 Workflow、一次异常接管、一次状态回写或回滚。Suggested recording: SOP to running workflow, one exception handoff, and one write-back or rollback.

请标注：真实 / 脱敏 / 模拟；视频观察不能自动等同于维修质量证明。Label as: real / de-identified / simulated; video observation is not proof of repair quality.

待补证据：正式名称、流程范围、系统归属、首个切片、现状样本与基线。Missing evidence: formal names, scope, system ownership, first slice, current sample and baseline.

049 · MD §D1.2.7.2 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.2

改造后闭环：每个状态都有证据与接管人After: every state has evidence and an owner

建议闭环：SOP → Workflow → 自然语言调整 → 验证与受控发布 → 运行反馈。Suggested loop: SOP → workflow → natural-language change → verified release → runtime feedback.

运行路径Runtime path

1
建议·正常任务SUGGESTED · NORMAL
从已确认 SOP 拆出步骤、角色、状态、校验、分支与异常；记录流程版本和状态事件。Decompose the confirmed SOP into steps, roles, states, checks, branches and exceptions; record version and events.
2
建议·缺失/异常SUGGESTED · MISSING/EXCEPTION
缺字段进入补件或人工队列；超时、冲突、未授权动作暂停并保留上下文。Missing fields go to completion or human queue; timeout, conflict or unauthorized action pauses with context retained.
3
建议·人确认/接管SUGGESTED · HUMAN REVIEW
业务审核变更，专家处理高风险分支和视频观察结果；确认后才继续。Business reviews changes; experts handle high-risk branches and video observations before continuation.

回写与最终结果Write-back and final result

4
建议·状态回写SUGGESTED · WRITE-BACK
把完成、未完成、异常、人工修正和回滚回写到 ISS Biz 确认的系统/表单；不假定已有集成。Write completion, unfinished, exception, manual fix and rollback to the ISS Biz-approved system/form; integration is not assumed.
5
建议·业务验收SUGGESTED · ACCEPTANCE
以任务完成、证据齐全、异常关闭、回写成功作为字段；不把流程图或视频识别当质量证明。Use task completion, evidence completeness, exception closure and successful write-back as fields; a diagram or video signal is not proof.
待补证据：状态字典、版本/回滚、未完成任务兼容、权限矩阵、回写字段、人工接管 SLA。Missing evidence: state dictionary, version/rollback, unfinished-task compatibility, permissions, write-back fields and human-handoff SLA.
讨论Discussion自然语言变更的差异、影响范围和回滚点，谁审核、谁发布？Who reviews and releases the diff, impact range and rollback point of a natural-language change?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.7.2
050 · MD §D1.2.7.3 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.3

实施：先用授权样本做小步闭环Implementation: close a small loop with authorized samples

输入必须可追溯；困难先作为验证项，不把未证实阻力写成历史事实。Inputs must be traceable. Treat difficulties as validation items, not as unverified history.

输入与建设Inputs and build

  • 已授权 SOP、脱敏任务样本、角色/权限、表单/数据字典。Authorized SOP, de-identified samples, roles/permissions, forms and data dictionary.
  • 允许执行的动作、异常案例、流程版本和回写要求。Allowed actions, exception cases, versions and write-back requirements.
  • 先配置最小 Workflow，以只读/建议模式检查状态与回写。Configure the minimum workflow; check states and write-back in read-only/suggestion mode.
若用视频IF VIDEO IS USED
先定采集范围、保存期限、脱敏、复核人和不可推断事项。Define scope, retention, de-identification, reviewer and non-inferable matters first.

六步落地Six steps

  1. ISS Biz 确认术语、边界、Owner、验收。ISS Biz confirms terms, boundary, owner and acceptance.
  2. SOP 拆成状态、分支、异常和证据字段。Break the SOP into states, branches, exceptions and evidence.
  3. 配置最小 Workflow，申请受控动作。Configure the minimum workflow; request controlled actions.
  4. 演示一次自然语言变更、回归、发布和回滚。Demonstrate one natural-language change, regression, release and rollback.
  5. 覆盖正常、缺失、异常、未完成和回滚用例。Cover normal, missing, exception, unfinished and rollback cases.
  6. 运行后由 Owner 审核事件、修正与知识更新。After runtime, the owner reviews events, fixes and knowledge updates.

采用与困难Adoption and risks

  • 建议用业务 Owner＋领域专家共同审查首条流程。Use a business owner and domain expert to review the first flow.
  • 可能困难：SOP 不细、权限不足、异常未记录、并行任务兼容未知、视频信号受遮挡。Possible issues: coarse SOP, limited permissions, unrecorded exceptions, unknown task compatibility, occluded video.
  • 建议用术语会、权限沙盒、异常剧本、双人复核、灰度发布和一键回滚。Suggested controls: terminology review, permission sandbox, exception drills, dual review, phased release and rollback.
  • 明确“建议/待确认/已发布/已回滚”，失败进入下一轮评测。Label “suggested/pending/released/rolled back”; feed failures into the next evaluation.
讨论Discussion谁带来第一份已授权 SOP 与脱敏样本？哪个步骤先保持只读或模拟？Who brings the first authorized SOP and de-identified sample? Which step stays read-only or simulated first?

价值证据：先定义分母，再谈效率与质量Value evidence: define the denominator before efficiency

以下是建议的职责与证据框架，不代表已发生组织转型或已有实测收益。The roles and evidence below are proposed; they do not claim an organizational transformation or measured gains.

职责边界（建议）Suggested boundaries

Tom
主持讨论与节奏。Facilitate and pace the discussion.
ITEM × COO AI Team/Hollis

DT

维度Dimension定义与分母Definition and denominator

待补：Owner/专家/运营确认、样本量、实测值、验收记录。Missing: owner/expert/operations confirmation, sample, measurements and acceptance record.

053 · MD §D1.2.7.6 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.6

思考：自然语言是入口，不是授权替代品Reflection: natural language is an entry point, not authorization

把每次业务变更变成可审核、可回归、可发布或回滚的链。Turn every business change into a chain that can be reviewed, regressed, released or rolled back.

建议变更链Suggested change chain

业务提规则Business proposes
→
专家审核Expert review
→
FDE 改FDE changes
→
回归Regression
→
发布/回滚Release/rollback
自然语言只负责表达意图；系统必须展示差异、影响、测试和回滚点。Natural language expresses intent; the system must show diff, impact, tests and rollback point.
视频观察仍需单独验证：误报/漏报、复核人、能否影响业务状态。Video observation needs separate validation: false positives/negatives, reviewer and whether it may affect business state.

可沉淀 vs 必须重验证Reuse vs re-validate

可沉淀核心Reusable core

  • SOP-to-Workflow 模板SOP-to-workflow template
  • 状态/权限/证据字典State/permission/evidence dictionary
  • 异常、接管、回滚 runbookException/handoff/rollback runbook
  • 回归用例、失败案例、运营台账Regression, failures, operations ledger

必须重验证Re-validate

  • 术语、SOP、角色权限Terms, SOP, role permissions
  • 接口、回写语义、兼容Interfaces, write-back semantics, compatibility
  • 异常分布、视频隐私边界Exception distribution, video privacy
  • 验收分母与业务结果Acceptance denominator and outcome

054 · MD §D1.2.7.7 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.7.7

可重复交付＋动手：现场产出一条可审计小流程Repeatable delivery + hands-on: leave with one auditable small flow

目标是产出草稿、能力卡、验收与责任，不因演示通过就强行产品化。Leave with a draft, capability card, acceptance and owners—not forced productization after a demo.

三步可重复交付Three repeatable steps

1授权低风险小流程，收集 SOP、样本、异常、角色、权限、状态、证据和接口。Authorize a low-risk slice; collect SOP, samples, exceptions, roles, permissions, states, evidence and interfaces.
2输出 Workflow 草稿、状态机、数据/动作清单和接管剧本；用自然语言改一条规则，展示差异、影响、回归与回滚点。Output the workflow draft, state machine, data/action list and handoff script; change one rule in natural language and show diff, impact, regression and rollback.
3专家审核、FDE/实现人员修改、业务验收后小范围发布；记录事件、异常、修正、完成/未完成、回滚和能力卡。Expert reviews, FDE/implementer changes, and business accepts before limited release; record events, exceptions, fixes, completion, rollback and the capability card.

现场动手、产出与停止线Hands-on, outputs and stop lines

带入与产出｜先建议/模拟Bring and produce | suggest/simulate first

带一条已授权 SOP、一个脱敏样本和一个要修改的规则；产出 Workflow 草稿、差异、回归用例、回滚点、能力卡、验收标准和责任分配。通用核心是版本化、权限/人工接管、接口确认、回归/回滚、证据台账与维护。Bring one authorized SOP, one de-identified sample and one rule; produce the draft, diff, regression cases, rollback point, capability card, acceptance and owners. Reusable core: versioning, permissions/handoff, interface confirmation, regression/rollback, evidence ledger and maintenance.

失败即缩小或转交Narrow or escalate on failure

术语、权限、接口、状态或证据不明，保持只读/模拟；异常无法安全接管或视频边界未明，停止自动动作并转交 ISS Biz/专家，不能强行产品化。If terms, permissions, interfaces, states or evidence are unclear, stay read-only/simulated; if handoff or video boundaries are unsafe, stop automation and escalate to ISS Biz/expert. Do not force productization.

讨论Discussion今天能否带走一份草稿、能力卡、验收标准和责任人，而不是一个流程图？Can we leave with a draft, capability card, acceptance criteria and owners—not just a diagram?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.7.7
055 · MD §D1.2.8.1 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.8.1

iCEO：先把业务边界说清iCEO: make the business boundary explicit first

已知：受控问答可行；当前复杂决策未达业务门槛。建议本轮先验证可追溯问答，不交付自动经营决策。Known: controlled Q&A is viable; complex decisions are below the business bar. Proposed: validate traceable Q&A first, not automated operating decisions.

改造前路径与痛点Current path and pain point

  • 知识采集 → 构建 PA（个人助理）→ 答复与决策。
  • 复杂决策同时依赖多维约束、动态背景、少量样本和隐性判断。
  • 演示流畅不能替代业务合格；本体不能补足缺失事实。
  • Knowledge capture → PA construction → answers and decisions.
  • Complex decisions depend on many constraints, dynamic context, sparse samples and tacit judgment.
  • A smooth demo is not business qualification; ontology cannot add missing facts.
预录视频｜待Tom放置Pre-recorded video | Tom to place

建议录制：同一请求分别走 Q&A、证据不足拒答、复杂决策转人工；标注“真实／脱敏／模拟”。Record: one request through Q&A, evidence-insufficient refusal and decision hand-off; label “real / anonymized / simulated”.

此处仅为有意义的预留位，不含假 src 或外链。Meaningful reserved slot only; no fake src or external iframe.

讨论DiscussionISS 首个任务是问答、辅助建议还是正式决策？它的证据和责任边界是什么？Is the first ISS task Q&A, an assisted recommendation or a formal decision? What are its evidence and accountability boundaries?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.8.1
056 · MD §D1.2.8.2 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.8.2

受控闭环：答复、拒答、接管、回写A controlled loop: answer, refuse, hand off, write back

建议把可验证的问答闭环先做实；复杂决策遇到缺证据或高风险时必须停下并交给人。Proposed: make the verifiable Q&A loop real first; stop and hand off complex decisions when evidence is missing or risk is high.

正常任务Normal task

  • 校验身份、权限、来源和敏感范围。
  • 检索有权限知识，返回证据与时间标记。
  • 仅输出 Q&A、整理或可回退建议。
  • Check identity, access, sources and sensitive scope.
  • Retrieve authorized knowledge with evidence and timestamps.
  • Return Q&A, organization or reversible advice only.

缺失信息／异常Missing or abnormal

  • 缺目标、事实、授权或可靠来源：澄清或拒答。
  • 知识冲突、过期、越权或正式决策请求：进入异常分支。
  • 不把本体当作完整经营背景。
  • Missing goals, facts, authorization or sources: clarify or refuse.
  • Conflicts, stale knowledge, overreach or formal decisions: exception path.
  • Do not treat ontology as full operating context.

人确认、状态与结果Human, status and outcome

  • ISS Biz (team) 作为业务 Owner 与验收方；专家复核高风险输出。
  • 建议回写任务分类、知识版本、证据、人工结论和时间戳。
  • 当前不声称存在成功决策执行或经营收益。
  • ISS Biz (team) owns business acceptance; experts review high-risk output.
  • Proposed write-back: task type, knowledge version, evidence, human conclusion and timestamp.
  • No claim of successful decision execution or operating benefit.
讨论Discussion现有入口、接管渠道和回写系统分别是什么？哪些请求必须直接转交？What are the current entry, hand-off channel and write-back system? Which requests must be handed off immediately?
ITEM × COO AI Team × ISS Biz (team)R5 · MD §D1.2.8.2
057 · MD §D1.2.8.3 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.8.3

实施：把失败条件变成可回归机制Implementation: turn failure conditions into regression mechanisms

已知困难是决策维度多、背景动态、样本少；以下建设与采用路径均为建议，不是已完成运营结果。Known difficulties are many dimensions, dynamic context and sparse samples; the build and adoption path below is proposed, not a completed operating result.

输入与建设Inputs and build

  • 先分类 Q&A、辅助分析、建议、正式决策。
  • 标注来源、权限、敏感级别、有效期和责任人。
  • 用真实脱敏样本建立可答／澄清／拒答／转交标签。
  • Classify Q&A, analysis, advice and formal decisions first.
  • Label sources, access, sensitivity, validity and owners.
  • Use real anonymized samples for answer/clarify/refuse/hand-off labels.

困难与克服（建议）Difficulties and mitigations (proposed)

  • 设置权限门、证据门、任务分类门和人工确认门。
  • 保留原始输入、知识版本、上下文和失败样本。
  • 高风险请求设停止条件，变更后做回归。
  • Use access, evidence, task-type and human-approval gates.
  • Keep original input, knowledge version, context and failure samples.
  • Set stop conditions for high risk and regress after changes.

推动采用与持续改进（建议）Adoption and continuous improvement (proposed)

  • 从一个低风险、边界清晰的问答任务开始。
  • 展示来源、限制和接管路径，教育“可答不等于可决策”。
  • 反馈按错误级别进入迭代队列；不把未证实阻力写成历史事实。
  • Start with one low-risk, clearly bounded Q&A task.
  • Show sources, limits and hand-off; teach that answerable is not decision-ready.
  • Route feedback by error level; do not invent historical resistance.
讨论Discussion能提供哪些真实脱敏样本？谁维护知识有效期并批准回归通过？Which real anonymized samples are available? Who maintains knowledge validity and approves regression release?

060 · MD §D1.2.8.6 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.8.6

思考：把业务变更做成可审计链Reflection: make business change an auditable chain

复用的是边界、审核、评测和回滚机制；每个新场景仍需重新验证目标、授权、样本与风险。Reuse boundaries, review, evaluation and rollback; every new scenario still revalidates goals, authorization, samples and risk.

业务变更链（建议）Business change chain (proposed)

业务提规则 → 专家审核 → FDE 改 → 回归 → ISS Biz (team) 验收 → 发布 → 监测 → 回滚／停止

Business proposes rule → expert review → FDE changes → regression → ISS Biz (team) accepts → release → monitor → rollback / stop

每个节点保留版本、责任人、证据和批准记录。

Keep version, owner, evidence and approval at every node.

可沉淀到核心知识库Assets for the core knowledge base

  • 审核后的概念、约束、权限和敏感信息规则。
  • 问答／拒答流程、人工接管、升级和运营机制。
  • 评测集、错误标签、回归结果、Skill／提示版本。
  • Reviewed concepts, constraints, access and sensitivity rules.
  • Q&A/refusal flow, human hand-off, escalation and operations.
  • Evaluation sets, error labels, regressions and Skill/prompt versions.

复用与重验证Reuse and revalidation

  • 复用：任务分类、证据门、人工门、日志、错误级别。
  • 重验：目标、数据权限、时效、样本分布、专家判断、接口副作用。
  • Q&A 可行不代表新场景决策可行。
  • Reuse: task types, evidence and human gates, logs and error levels.
  • Revalidate goals, data access, freshness, sample mix, judgment and side effects.
  • Viable Q&A does not make a new decision scenario viable.
讨论Discussion当前谁批准规则、谁改实现、谁验收、谁能回滚？哪些知识有授权可沉淀？Who approves rules, changes implementation, accepts release and can roll back? Which knowledge is authorized to persist?

061 · MD §D1.2.8.7 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.8.7

可重复交付：小范围能力卡与停止机制Repeatable delivery: a small capability card and stop rule

失败例也可以复用方法，但不能强行产品化。现场只做一个可审计的小范围草稿，无法验收就停止或转交。A failure case can reuse method, but must not be forced into a product. Draft one auditable small-scope card; stop or hand off if it cannot be accepted.

六步交付法（建议）Six-step delivery (proposed)

  1. 选任务并分类。
  2. 写清权限、目标、禁止输出和停止条件。
  3. 准备真实脱敏样本并标注模拟样本。
  4. 配置知识、Skill、接口和状态回写。
  5. 评测引用、权限、拒答、转交和错误级别。
  6. ISS Biz (team) 决定发布、研究、停止或转交。
  1. Select and classify the task.
  2. Define access, goal, prohibited output and stop rule.
  3. Prepare real anonymized samples and label simulations.
  4. Configure knowledge, Skill, interfaces and write-back.
  5. Evaluate evidence, access, refusal, hand-off and error level.
  6. ISS Biz (team) decides release, research, stop or hand-off.

现场动手：能力卡Hands-on: capability card

  • 现场修改一条 Q&A 规则或转交流程。
  • 产出：输入、允许输出、拒答条件、人工接管、证据字段。
  • 补齐：验收分母／周期、错误级别、责任人、回滚条件。
  • Modify one Q&A rule or hand-off flow in the room.
  • Produce: inputs, allowed output, refusal, human hand-off and evidence fields.
  • Add denominator/period, error level, owner and rollback condition.

停止／转交门槛Stop / hand-off gate

若没有责任授权、真实样本或可验证目标，产出停止／转交草稿，不强行产品化；需要完整经营背景或稀缺数据的任务交给相应团队。

Without accountability, real samples or a testable goal, produce a stop/hand-off draft rather than force productization. Hand off tasks needing full operating context or scarce data.

待补：规则版本、样本、验收签字与回滚确认。

Missing: rule version, samples, acceptance sign-off and rollback confirmation.

讨论Discussion今天选择哪条规则？谁现场修改、谁验收？若证据不足，停止还是转交给谁？Which rule do we choose today? Who changes and accepts it? If evidence is missing, do we stop or hand off to whom?

065 · MD §D1.2.9.3 · 九案例与组织实践Nine cases and operating change
DAY 1 · MD §D1.2.9.3

实施过程：先缩小验证，再持续改进Implementation: Narrow Validation, Then Improve

把“模型训练”从默认起点改成有证据才进入的选项，并把失败样例保留在回归循环里。Make model training an evidence-based option, not the default starting point; keep failures in the regression loop.

01

输入先变可验收Make inputs testable

  • 从实际业务问题收集知识，不继续堆资料。
  • 补来源、有效期、审核人、用途、角色、流程和更新责任。
  • HR 任务先写合规边界、人工审批和决策责任。
  • Collect knowledge from real tasks, not more documents.
  • Add source, validity, reviewer, purpose, role, workflow, and update owner.
  • For HR, define compliance, human approval, and decision ownership first.
02

最小验证与克服困难Minimum validation

  • 先验证知识质量、检索、权限、规则和现有模型。
  • 用来源、结构化输出、工具验证和拒答/澄清/转人工降低幻觉。
  • 用全生命周期成本、质量、维护、评测和迁移成本比较方案。
  • Validate knowledge, retrieval, access, rules, and existing models first.
  • Use sources, structured output, tools, and reject/clarify/hand-off controls.
  • Compare lifecycle cost, quality, maintenance, evaluation, and migration.
03

采用与持续改进Adoption and improvement

  • 建议：从低风险、边界清楚的一个任务开始。
  • 展示输入—输出—接管记录，再按错误级别扩展。
  • 把反馈分成知识、权限、规则、检索、模型和运营问题。
  • Proposed: start with one low-risk, bounded task.
  • Show input-output-takeover evidence before expanding by error level.
  • Classify feedback as knowledge, access, rules, retrieval, model, or operations.
